T: The story of an uncommonly gentle man.
D: An unfinished man with scissors for hands is taken home by an Avon lady to her pastel suburb, where he trims hedges, cuts hair and falls for her daughter.
P: Serve the pie when Edward carves the ice and the shavings fall like snow.
S: The Boggses throw Edward a barbecue
Mix the barbecue sauce, honey, paprika and oil and coat the chicken. Thread onto the skewers. Grill, turning and basting with the sauce, until sticky and cooked through. Scatter with spring onion.
700g chicken thigh fillets, cut in chunks@Meat
Edward trims the hedges into animals

Blitz the yoghurt, mayo, herbs, lemon and garlic until smooth and green, and season. Blanch the broccolini and snap peas for a minute, then cool in iced water. Stand the vegetables up in glasses and bowls like a clipped garden around the dip.
M: Come home with me glazed meatloaf
Peg takes Edward home with her

Mix the mince, onion, carrot, breadcrumbs, egg, thyme and 2 tbsp tomato sauce with salt and shape into a loaf in a lined tin. Stir the tomato sauce, sugar and vinegar, spread half over the loaf and bake at 180C. Spread on the rest of the glaze and bake until sticky and cooked through, then rest. Boil and mash the potatoes with the butter and milk, cook the peas, and serve thick slices of loaf on top.
125ml tomato sauce, plus 2 tbsp for the mix@Pantry

Peel the rind off the ham, leaving the fat, then score the fat in a diamond pattern and stud with cloves. Simmer the maple, orange, mustard and sugar until syrupy. Bake the ham at 180C, brushing with glaze every 15 minutes, until deep amber. Rest and carve at the table.
2.5kg half leg ham on the bone@Meat
W: Peg the Avon lady calls at the castle

Simmer the cherry juice, sugar and cornflour until thick, then stir in the cherries, lemon and vanilla and cool. Line a pie dish with one pastry sheet, fill with the cherries and cut the other sheet into strips for a lattice. Brush with egg, sprinkle with raw sugar and bake at 200C until golden and bubbling. Cool a little and serve with ice cream.
2 x 680g jars pitted morello cherries, drained, 250ml juice kept@Pantry
K: Bill is just as pleased as punch
Crush half the raspberries with the sugar and lemon juice and strain into a punch bowl. Add the ice, lemonade and soda. Float the rest of the raspberries and the mint on top and ladle into glasses.
